name: Atramento Remedium
source:
After an unfortunate “accident” with the last research lead, a new doctor has taken over project Atramento Remedium. At least, that’s what they call their excuse to imprison you, cut you open, and take whatever they need. 

But this new doctor made a grave mistake. Now you know they might just have a conscience. Alone with them in their office, this could be your chance. Will you finally escape? And if you do… what will be left?

[From [url=https://cerezaraine.itch.io/atramento-remedium]Itch.io[/url]]
